node.title: Re: tzset and POSIX
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Looking at the [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=SVG-TT-Graph%201.02;maxver=1|CPAN Testers Matrix], the tests on Windows started failing in 1.02, although the tzset call was [https://github.com/ranguard/svg-tt-graph/commit/5045e1db1|introduced] in 1.01. However, the [https://github.com/ranguard/svg-tt-graph/compare/1.01...1.02|changes] between 1.01 and 1.02 are so minimal (just [https://github.com/ranguard/svg-tt-graph/commit/91aeed34|one patch]) that unless that bug is affecting you, you could just as well install 1.01, or comment out the offending tzset line. But I'd definitely also file an [https://github.com/ranguard/svg-tt-graph/issues|issue] with the maintainer, since this is clearly a regression on Windows.
